text: You'll also be eating a lot more potassium than most people get, so consult a doctor first if you have kidney disease or heart conditions, or take a blood pressure drug that holds on to potassium. Those are the ACE inhibitors and ARBs, and with either kind, or with weak kidneys, potassium can build up in your blood.
